_note: Spatial calibration for the 1632x1224 mode (run2-run10). Measured by hand from the median ruler profile: two grid lines (0.1 mm = 100 um apart) at x ~= 350 and x ~= 1045 px -> 695 px per 100 um. The FFT auto-value was a harmonic artifact and is NOT used.

method: manual two-point on median ruler profile
